description: Rehearsal Mass for tests/e2e/massRehearsal.spec.js. Two timed gathering text slides of 4 seconds each, then a Mass with an opening hymn, the first reading, an image slide, the psalm, a prayer, and the Gospel. The reading files are written to a readings folder and loaded first. The sequence and manual slides are then saved through /api/organizer.

readings.Reading_I.txt:
Genesis 1:1-3

In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
readings.Responsorial_Psalm.txt:
